name: rules.realtime

list.description: List realtime rules with full native fields.

get.description: Query native detail by id; reads online without changing the saved list.

lookup.name: Id
lookup.description: Native Id lookup value; use the id value from a List row.

result_identity.description: Native detail id identity; validated against the requested Id.

purpose: Inspect realtime rules through their native inquiry without changing configuration.

fields.name: id
fields.meaning: Native record identity; original JSON type is retained.

identity_description: Native id identifies each record; no synthetic identity is created.
limitations: Fixed native pageSize=10; rowStart offsets start at zero.
Native endpoint has no page echoes. Completeness requires fixed total, arrival and unique identity agreement.
Unknown fields, native JSON types and exact decimal values are retained.
Pinned v0.4.3 provides contract provenance; current production qualification is recorded separately.
Native request has no tenant or timeZone field.
Native detail uses POST json /api/realtime/rule/getDetail.json; sends Id as a string without tenant or timeZone.
Detail returns one native root response; separate histories, logs and child pages are not queried.

List with --live --with-detail fetches detail only for the selected offset/limit window as separate record/detail members; any detail failure fails the whole query. Get and combined queries preserve the saved List.

examples.title: Read one List row with its native detail
